messages:
mike: CI red on main, noticed intermittent failure in serve/retry/backoff_test. started failing in linux-amd64 shard. https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4721 — can someone take a quick look?
ci-bot: Build 4721 • linux-amd64 • FAILED
ci-bot: --- FAIL: TestBackoffRetry (0.22s)
ci-bot: 	retry_test.go:78: expected 3 attempts, got 1
ci-bot: 	--- stdout:
ci-bot: 	2026-03-17T10:12:34Z failed to send request: context deadline exceeded
ci-bot: commit: 8f3c2a9 (merge main)
maria: hmm, that looks like the timeout path triggered immediately. Was there any recent change to the retry backoff or to the test harness?
raj: afaict PR #298 touched the retry jitter code and the test was slightly modified (shortened deadlines). pinging @mike since you reviewed it.
mike: yeah i approved that change last week — it shortened the per-attempt ctx to speed tests. maybe too aggressive.
maria: can we try a quick rerun with -count=50 to see flake rate? also run with LOG_RETRY=1 to capture timing.
tim: doing a quick rerun on the failing shard now: `go test ./serve -run TestBackoffRetry -count=50 -v` (will post results)
ci-bot: Rerun 4721.1 triggered by tim (rerun with -count=50).
ci-bot: Rerun results: 50 runs — 48 passed, 2 failed (non-deterministic). Failures show same assertion: expected 3 attempts, got 1 and context deadline exceeded immediately.
maria: ok so it's flaky but uncommon (4%). likely a race between deadline propagation and retry scheduling.
raj: could be that shortened ctx cancels too early when combined with runtime scheduling pauses. any test harness sleeps or fake timers?
mike: test uses real timers, but we stub network with a fake client that sometimes does a tiny schedule yield.
maria: two quick mitigations: 1) expand per-attempt timeout in test to be more permissive, 2) add a subtest that runs many iterations and only asserts on statistical failure rate. But we should root cause the regression in PR #298.
tim: i'll try bisect locally between commit 7a1b..8f3c2a9 tomorrow with `git bisect run` + the test command. also will instrument LOG_RETRY timestamps to see if ctx cancellation arrives before attempt start.
raj: also consider adding a synthetic scheduling pause in the harness to reproduce the race. if you can repro locally please open a minimal test to make the flake deterministic.
mike: filing a short task in the board: BACKOFF-FLAKE-452. tim, can you own the bisect + minimal repro? :thumbsup:
tim: will do. timeline: bisect tomorrow morning, share results here. if i find a quick guard i'll open a PR to relax deadline on the test (temporary) and link the bisect.
maria: thanks — also add the CI shard and rerun command into the issue so we can automate a daily flakey run.
ci-bot: noted — added comment to BACKOFF-FLAKE-452 with last run stats.
mike: cool. if anyone finds a deterministic seed or loop that reproduces the exact failure ping me. otherwise await bisect results.
(reacts: mike :eyes:, tim :rocket:)
